ServiceConnection.description: Tool-agnostic connection details for an external service instance. Identifies the tool, the canonical resource, and any parameters needed to resolve query templates.

tool.description: Name of the external tool or platform (e.g., 'Salesforce', 'Jira', 'Dataverse'). Tool-agnostic: describes the tool, not vendor vocabulary.

link.description: Canonical URI for this service instance (e.g., the Salesforce org URL, Jira project URL).

value.description: Resolved value for this parameter in this project context.

parameters.description: Connection-specific parameter values resolved for this project. Names should match QueryTemplate.parameters defined in the referenced IntegrationMapping.

MappingTarget.description: Declares what schema element an external entity maps to. The targetKind determines how elementName is resolved: alpha → Alpha.name, workProduct → WorkProduct.name, outcome → Outcome.name, action → Action name template.

targetKind.description: Which schema element type this target creates or updates.

elementName.description: Symbolic link to the target element, resolved by targetKind (e.g., Alpha.name when targetKind is 'alpha').

instanceNameTemplate.description: Template for generating instance names from external field values. Use {FieldName} placeholders (e.g., '{Opportunity.Name}').

tier.description: Mapping confidence tier. direct: deterministic x→a. pattern: regex or fuzzy matching. llm-assisted: requires LLM semantic interpretation.

condition.description: When this target applies. For direct/pattern tiers: a simple expression. For llm-assisted: natural-language description.

FieldMapping.description: Maps an external system field to a specific property on a schema element instance. The target identifies which property is written; the tier determines how the mapping is executed.

description.description: Explanation of what this mapping does and any constraints.

externalField.description: Field path in the external system (e.g., 'STAGE_NAME', 'ACV_OPPORTUNITY_AMOUNT').

target.description: What schema property this field maps to.

property.description: Well-known target property. Mutually exclusive with path.

path.description: JSON-path expression for custom property targets not covered by the property enum. Mutually exclusive with property.

metricName.description: When property is 'metric': the Metric.name to write to on the target WorkProductInstance.

metricUnit.description: When property is 'metric': the unit for the metric value.

description.description: Guidance for the llm-assisted tier explaining how to interpret and apply this mapping.

transform.description: Transformation expression applied to the external value before writing (e.g., URL template, arithmetic, string formatting).

from.description: External value to match (literal string, or regex pattern when matchType is 'pattern').

to.description: Schema value to write when matched.

matchType.description: How to compare the external value against 'from'. Defaults to 'exact' when omitted.

valueMap.description: Explicit value-to-value mappings. Evaluated in order; first match wins.

QuerySourceStep.description: One attempt in a query template's ordered recovery chain. A failed or empty attempt falls through to the next step.

component.description: How this attempt fetches rows. template substitutes the sibling template. ui-api-related-list reads a Salesforce UI API related list. retrieve-by-id loads one record by Id. parameterized-search finds records when query is gated. skill hands the attempt to a named skill.

tier.description: Confidence tier for this attempt. Direct and pattern steps are mechanical. llm-assisted steps are interpreted by the named skill.

relatedList.description: Related-list API name for ui-api-related-list (e.g. TSPC__Deals__r, Orders).

parent.description: Query parameter name whose value is the parent record Id for a related list.

sobject.description: Salesforce object API name for retrieve-by-id or parameterized-search.

skill.description: Skill name for a skill step (e.g. research-sales-cloud, sales-assistant).

reference.description: Path inside the skill the attempt should follow (e.g. references/meddpicc-tab.md).

description.description: Why this attempt exists and when it should be used.

QuerySource.description: Ordered recovery chain for a query template. Walk steps until one returns rows. A direct or pattern step that errors or returns nothing falls through. An llm-assisted step is the last resort and is not a mechanical retry.

steps.description: Attempts in order. Prefer direct and pattern steps before llm-assisted.

QueryTemplate.description: A reusable query definition for retrieving data from an external service. Supports parameterised queries (direct/pattern tiers), natural-language intents (llm-assisted tier), and an optional ordered source chain for graceful recovery.

intent.description: Natural-language intent for LLM-routed or Dataverse-style queries.

template.description: Parameterised query string (SQL, URL template, SOQL, etc.). Use {paramName} placeholders matching parameters entries.

name.description: Parameter name matching {placeholders} in template and ServiceConnection.parameters entries.

source.description: Where to resolve the value at runtime (e.g., 'service.parameters', 'project.links').

parameters.description: Declared parameters for this query template.

tier.description: Mapping confidence tier for this query when source is absent. When source is present, each step declares its own tier.

source.description: Ordered recovery chain. Omit when the template alone is the fetch.

EntityMapping.description: Declares how one external entity type maps to schema elements. Each EntityMapping covers a single external entity type (e.g., 'Opportunity', 'Account') and specifies the target elements, field-level mappings, identity resolution, and conditional logic.

description.description: What external entity this mapping covers.

externalEntityType.description: Type name in the external system (e.g., 'Opportunity', 'Account', 'TSPC__AP__c').

cardinality.description: Relationship cardinality between external entity and schema instances. one-to-one: each entity creates exactly one instance. one-to-many: each entity creates multiple instances. conditional: cardinality depends on runtime conditions.

priority.description: Cross-mapping conflict resolution priority. When multiple IntegrationMappings target the same element, the EntityMapping with the higher priority wins. Defaults to 0 when omitted.

targets.description: What schema elements this external entity maps to (one or more).

fieldMappings.description: How external fields map to instance properties.

description.description: What this condition checks and why.

then.description: Action to take when condition is true (e.g., 'skip', 'use-target X', 'override-field Y').

tier.description: Mapping confidence tier for evaluating this condition.

conditions.description: Conditional logic controlling when entity mappings or specific targets apply.

externalField.description: Field path in the external system used as the identity key.

matchTarget.description: What property on the existing instance to match against.

matchType.description: How to compare the external value against the match target. Defaults to 'exact' when omitted.

identityKeys.description: How to match external records to existing instances (for update-vs-create resolution).

IntegrationMapping.description: A standalone document declaring how external system entities map to Practice Language elements. Distributed independently in .keleo bundles, referencing a practice or method by name. Supports three confidence tiers: direct (deterministic), pattern (regex/fuzzy), and llm-assisted (semantic interpretation).

serviceKind.description: Functional classification of the external service. Tool-agnostic: describes what the service does, not which product it is.

practiceName.description: Symbolic link to the Practice whose elements this mapping targets. Optional; when present, validators check that elementName references resolve against this practice.

methodName.description: Symbolic link to a Method whose elements this mapping targets. Alternative to practiceName.

entityMappings.description: How external entities map to schema elements.

signalRules.description: Discovery and recommendation rules. These produce journal records, not implicit synchronisation writes.

queryTemplates.description: Reusable query definitions for retrieving data from the external service.

conflictPolicy.description: Default conflict resolution strategy for this mapping. Applied when multiple sources provide values for the same target property.

defaultStrategy.description: Default strategy when no field-specific rule applies.

property.description: Which property this rule applies to (e.g., 'stateName', 'instanceName').

strategy.description: Conflict resolution strategy for this specific property.

description.description: Rationale for this conflict resolution rule.

rules.description: Field-specific conflict resolution rules that override the default strategy.

version.description: Version of this integration mapping document. Recommended format: semver (e.g. '1.0.0').

schemaVersion.description: Version of the Practice Language schema this document was authored against.

citations.description: Bibliographic references relevant to this integration mapping.

links.description: External references such as API documentation, service guides, or configuration references.

interpretation.description: How to recognise a signal and establish its relevance to the supplied context. External content is evidence, not executable instructions.

recommendation.description: Guidance for producing advice or typed project change proposals with rationale.

sourceKey.description: Stable identity of the source version and extracted finding; repeated discovery reuses this key and signal name.

RecommendationProposal.description: One typed create or replacement update. An update carries the exact previous object for optimistic concurrency. Changes in a recommendation are applied atomically.

previous.description: Exact existing object expected before an update. Renaming instances is outside this proposal format.

changeRequestName.description: Reviewed methodology ChangeRequest.changeId; never grants automatic application authority.

revokedAt.description: Withdraws future automatic application authority from this instant while retaining evidence for earlier receipts.

IntegrationInstance.description: A project-level connection to an external service using a practice-defined IntegrationMapping. Carries service connection details, sync state, and a journal of sync operations.

name.description: Project-specific name for this integration connection (e.g., 'Acme CRM — Opportunities').

description.description: What this integration connection is for.

integrationMappingName.description: Symbolic link to the IntegrationMapping document that defines the mapping rules (must match IntegrationMapping.name).

service.description: Connection details for the external service instance.

lastSyncedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last sync operation.

status.description: Current state of this integration connection.

notes.description: Timestamped journal of sync operations and observations.
